label: getUser [server]
description: The getUser function returns the corresponding user information.
signature: function getUser({ userPoolId, username, }: GetUserInterface): Promise<Response>

userPoolId.description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool from which to retrieve the user.

username.description: The username of the user to retrieve.

returns.description: A promise that resolves to a Response object containing the user details.

examples.description: Retrieve user details for a given username in a Cognito User Pool.

notes: Ensure the provided userPoolId is valid and that the username exists in the pool.
This function requires appropriate IAM permissions to read user details from the Cognito User Pool.

see_also.label: adminGetUser
see_also.description: Retrieves user attributes for a specific user in an Amazon Cognito user pool.
